scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev -w backend" "npm start -w frontend"
scripts.db:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.dev.yaml up -d --build db migrate
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run build:migrate -w backend && node --env-file-if-exists=.env backend/dist/apps/migrate/main.js
